Create an interactive scatter plot.

Source: R/scatterPlot.R
scatter_plot.Rd

Plots two numeric variables against each other. Points can be coloured by a group (categorical or continuous), sized by a third variable (bubble chart), labelled, and summarised with a linear or LOESS trend line and its confidence band. The chart is interactive: hovering a point shows its values, the legend hides or isolates groups, and dragging a box selects points, which can then be zoomed into.

Usage

scatter_plot(
  data,
  x,
  y,
  col = NULL,
  size = 4,
  xticks = NULL,
  yticks = NULL,
  xtitle = NULL,
  xtitleFontSize = 13,
  ytitle = NULL,
  ytitleFontSize = 13,
  title = NULL,
  titleFontSize = 20,
  stroke = NULL,
  strokeWidth = NULL,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  bgcol = "white",
  opacity = 0.8,
  axisCol = "#333333",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  sizeBy = NULL,
  sizeRange = c(3, 16),
  label = NULL,
  showLabels = NULL,
  tooltip = TRUE,
  trend = c("none", "lm", "loess"),
  ci = TRUE,
  span = 0.75,
  xScale = c("linear", "log"),
  yScale = c("linear", "log"),
  hlines = NULL,
  vlines = NULL,
  legend = NULL,
  brush = TRUE,
  animate = TRUE,
  xFormat = NULL,
  yFormat = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  subtitleFontSize = 13,
  gridCol = "#e9e9e9"
)

Arguments

data

The data frame containing the variables.

x

The name of the numeric x-variable.

y

The name of the numeric y-variable.

col

Colour of the points. A single colour when there is no group. With a categorical group, a vector of colours (recycled; a named vector maps colours to groups). With a numeric group, two colours or more define the gradient. Defaults to a built-in palette (viridis for a numeric group).

size

The radius of the points in pixels when sizeBy is not used. Defaults to 4.

xticks

Optional. The approximate number of x-axis ticks.

yticks

Optional. The approximate number of y-axis ticks.

xtitle

Optional. The title of the x-axis. Defaults to the name of x; use "" to hide it.

xtitleFontSize

The font size of the x-axis title. Defaults to 13.

ytitle

Optional. The title of the y-axis, drawn above the axis. Defaults to the name of y; use "" to hide it.

ytitleFontSize

The font size of the y-axis title. Defaults to 13.

title

Optional. The title of the plot.

titleFontSize

The font size of the plot title. Defaults to 20.

stroke

Optional. The stroke colour of the points. Defaults to the background colour, which separates overlapping points.

strokeWidth

Optional. The stroke width of the points.

font

The font family to consider for the titles. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

bgcol

The background color of the SVG. Defaults to "white".

opacity

The opacity of the points (from 0 to 1). Defaults to 0.8.

axisCol

The colour of the axes, labels and titles. Defaults to "#333333".

width

Optional. The width of the SVG output.

height

Optional. The height of the SVG output.

group

Optional. The name of a column used to colour the points. A character, factor or logical column gives one colour per group and a clickable legend; a numeric column gives a colour gradient. Use as.factor() to treat a numeric column as categories.

sizeBy

Optional. The name of a numeric column mapped to the point area (bubble chart).

sizeRange

The minimum and maximum radius in pixels used with sizeBy. Defaults to c(3, 16).

label

Optional. The name of a column identifying each point. It is used as the tooltip title and by showLabels.

showLabels

Optional. Draws text labels next to points: TRUE labels every point, a character vector labels the points whose label matches. Requires label.

tooltip

TRUE (default) shows a tooltip on hover, FALSE disables it. A character vector of column names adds those columns to the tooltip.

trend

Adds a trend line: "none" (default), "lm" (linear regression) or "loess". With a categorical group, one line is fitted per group. With a log scale, the fit is computed on the log values.

ci

Logical. Draw the 95% confidence band around the trend line. Defaults to TRUE.

span

The LOESS smoothing parameter. Defaults to 0.75.

xScale

The x-axis scale: "linear" (default) or "log". Rows with non-positive values are dropped with a log scale.

yScale

The y-axis scale: "linear" (default) or "log".

hlines

Optional. Numeric values drawn as horizontal dashed reference lines; names are used as labels.

vlines

Optional. Numeric values drawn as vertical dashed reference lines; names are used as labels.

legend

Logical. Show the legend. When NULL (default), it is shown when group or sizeBy is used.

brush

Logical. Enable drag-to-select and zoom. Defaults to TRUE.

animate

Logical. Animate the points when the chart is first drawn. Defaults to TRUE.

xFormat, yFormat

Optional. d3-format strings for the axes and the tooltip, e.g. ",.0f", ".1%" or "$,.2f".

subtitle

Optional. A subtitle drawn under the title.

subtitleFontSize

The font size of the subtitle. Defaults to 13.

gridCol

The colour of the grid lines. Defaults to "#e9e9e9"; use NA to hide them.

Value

An interactive SVG scatter plot (an r2d3 htmlwidget).

Interactions

  • Hover a point to see its values; hover a trend line to see the fit (slope, intercept and R-squared for trend = "lm").

  • Click a legend entry to hide or show a group, double-click it to isolate it. Hovering a legend entry highlights the group.

  • Drag on the chart to select points (when brush = TRUE). The toolbar then offers Zoom and Clear. Double-click the chart to reset the zoom.

Shiny

Inside Shiny, with r2d3::d3Output("id") and r2d3::renderD3(), the chart sets two inputs: input$id_selected, the row numbers of data inside the brushed box (NULL when the selection is cleared), and input$id_clicked, the row number of the last clicked point. Hidden groups and the zoom are kept when the chart is re-rendered with the same x and y.

Examples


scatter_plot(
  data = mtcars,
  x = "wt",
  y = "mpg"
)



# Colour by group, one linear fit per group
scatter_plot(
  data = iris,
  x = "Sepal.Length",
  y = "Petal.Length",
  group = "Species",
  trend = "lm",
  title = "Petal and sepal length"
)



# Bubble chart with a continuous colour scale, labels and extra tooltip rows
cars <- mtcars
cars$model <- rownames(mtcars)
scatter_plot(
  data = cars,
  x = "hp",
  y = "mpg",
  sizeBy = "disp",
  group = "qsec",
  label = "model",
  showLabels = c("Maserati Bora", "Toyota Corolla", "Lotus Europa"),
  tooltip = c("cyl", "gear"),
  trend = "loess",
  title = "Horsepower and fuel economy",
  subtitle = "Bubble area: displacement; colour: quarter-mile time"
)



# Log scales and reference lines
scatter_plot(
  data = data.frame(area = state.x77[, "Area"],
                    population = state.x77[, "Population"],
                    state = rownames(state.x77)),
  x = "area",
  y = "population",
  label = "state",
  xScale = "log",
  yScale = "log",
  hlines = c("Median" = 2838.5)
)
